title: Speaking — Solving problems
description: Part 1 interview, a cue card and a Part 3 discussion on solving problems.

questions: Where do you usually spend time with friends?
How do you keep in touch with friends you rarely see?
What kinds of activities do you normally do together?
Do you prefer meeting one friend or a group?
When a small problem occurs, do you usually ask for help?
Do you enjoy trying several ways to solve a problem?

part2.topic: Describe a problem you solved after an initial attempt failed.
part2.closing: and explain what you would do differently next time.

questions: Why might organisations benefit from discussing their mistakes openly?
How can schools assess problem-solving without rewarding only one correct method?
How has everyday life connected with solving problems changed for people of different ages?
